cards.title: Notice the Effort
cards.instruction: Make your invisible labor visible through pointed reminders, strategic sighs, and opportunities for appreciation.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Four hours clean. The shelf has a history.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thank you.
